description: Observability dashboard for the CardDemo Java (Spring Boot) migration: HTTP request/error/latency, Spring Batch pipeline throughput, authentication outcomes, and JVM/GC/process health. Scraped from /actuator/prometheus.

panels.description: Aggregate HTTP request throughput across all endpoints.
panels.title: Total Request Rate

panels.description: Server-error (HTTP 5xx) request rate.
panels.title: 5xx Error Rate

panels.description: Client-error (HTTP 4xx) request rate.
panels.title: 4xx Error Rate

panels.description: Fraction of requests returning HTTP 5xx.
panels.title: 5xx Error Ratio

panels.description: Per-endpoint request rate, broken down by HTTP method and URI.
panels.title: Request Rate by URI

panels.description: 4xx and 5xx request rate grouped by HTTP status code.
panels.title: Error Rate by Status

panels.description: Request latency percentiles computed from the Micrometer histogram (requires percentiles-histogram for http.server.requests).
panels.title: Request Latency p50 / p95 / p99

panels.description: Mean request latency = rate(_sum) / rate(_count).
panels.title: Average Request Latency

panels.description: Batch records processed per second (carddemo.batch.records.processed -> carddemo_batch_records_processed_total).
panels.title: Records Processed / sec

panels.description: Batch records rejected per second, broken down by reason tag (carddemo.batch.records.rejected -> carddemo_batch_records_rejected_total).
panels.title: Records Rejected / sec by Reason

panels.description: Cumulative batch records processed.
panels.title: Total Records Processed

panels.description: Cumulative batch records rejected.
panels.title: Total Records Rejected

panels.description: Summed monetary amount of processed transactions (carddemo.transaction.amount.total -> carddemo_transaction_amount_total).
panels.title: Transaction Amount Total

panels.description: Rate of summed transaction amount.
panels.title: Transaction Amount Rate

panels.description: Authentication attempts per second by outcome (carddemo.auth.attempts -> carddemo_auth_attempts_total; outcome = success/failure).
panels.title: Auth Attempt Rate by Outcome

panels.description: Cumulative authentication attempts by outcome (success vs failure).
panels.title: Auth Attempts Total by Outcome

panels.description: JVM memory used, split by heap / nonheap area.
panels.title: JVM Memory Used by Area

panels.description: Garbage-collection pause events per second, by action and cause.
panels.title: GC Pause Rate

panels.description: Average and maximum GC pause duration.
panels.title: GC Pause Duration (avg / max)

panels.description: Current live JVM thread count.
panels.title: Live Threads

panels.description: JVM process CPU utilisation (0-1).
panels.title: Process CPU Usage

panels.description: Host system CPU utilisation (0-1).
panels.title: System CPU Usage

title: CardDemo Java — Observability
